finding: The possibility-preprocessor direction has first measured synthetic support and independent external precedent for graph-expanded/structured retrieval. The internal measurement is correlated with implementation design and must not be conflated with the external studies or treated as independent replication of Clay results.
method_rule: Promote no superiority claim until held-out real Clay/FRANK snapshots use independent episode/seed units and include lexical, dense/late-interaction and graph-RAG baselines plus null/stale/corrupt/edge-lesion tests, latency/memory/rebuild/token accounting and downstream task outcome.
counterhypotheses: Internal synthetic labels may align with mechanism design.
Graph complexity may not survive real-data noise/cost.
Retrieval quality gains may fail to improve downstream answers.
ancestry_policy: Internal benchmark iterations share lineage and count once; external papers are independent studies on different systems, not replications of Clay/FRANK.
